title: bar frame settings
description: Settings for the bar frame type (epic web zones R2). A missing field takes its default.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: How each tale group is drawn. ring: the cover in a ring, the default look; applies shape, size, showTitles, alignment and gap. chip: a round cover beside its title in a pill; shape is ignored. poster: a tall card with the title over the cover; shape and size are ignored. stack: the items overlap in one collapsed row; only size applies, and shape, showTitles, alignment and gap are ignored.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The shape of each tale group's cover.

showTitles.title: Show titles
showTitles.description: Show each tale group's title under its cover.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Where the items sit when they do not fill the row.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Space between items, in pixels, from 4 to 24.
